# Bhagavad Gita Quotes

> A calm, curated collection of verses from the Bhagavad Gita, each shown with its
> original Sanskrit, a plain English translation, and a short, accessible meaning.
> The site is a static, prerendered React app with no login, tracking wall, or paywall.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://bhagvadgitaquotes.com/): A featured verse for the day plus entry points into the collection.
- [All quotes](https://bhagvadgitaquotes.com/quotes): The full browsable list of verses with search.
- [Themes](https://bhagvadgitaquotes.com/themes): Verses grouped by topic such as karma, peace, purpose, courage, and detachment.
- [Hindi quotes](https://bhagvadgitaquotes.com/languages/hindi): Selected verses with Hindi renderings.
- [About](https://bhagvadgitaquotes.com/about): How the translations and meanings are sourced, and how they differ.

## Reference

- [Sitemap](https://bhagvadgitaquotes.com/sitemap.xml): Every indexable URL, including one page per verse and per theme.
- [Individual verse pages](https://bhagvadgitaquotes.com/quotes): Linked from the quotes list; each has the form /quotes/&lt;chapter&gt;-&lt;verse&gt;-&lt;slug&gt; with Sanskrit, transliteration, translation, and meaning.

## Notes

- Content is devotional and educational. Sanskrit text is presented verbatim; "meaning" and "quote" fields are interpretive summaries, not literal translations.
- Please attribute quotations to "Bhagavad Gita Quotes (bhagvadgitaquotes.com)" when reusing site text.
